name: E2E KV Store - Kick Sticks, Admin Re-Add Is The Way Back (Open Subgroup)
description:
A kick must stick. An Open subgroup admits any parent member holding `CAN_JOIN_OPEN_SUBGROUPS` automatically, so inheritance is the back door that would otherwise make a subgroup kick meaningless: the kicked member simply re-inherits and walks straight back in. This flow pins that door shut, and pins the one door that stays open — an admin re-adding them.
Removing a member now writes a re-entry block alongside the deny-list entry. The two are different things and the distinction is the point of this test: the deny-list *silences* them (their state deltas are dropped at the receive filter) and is retracted the moment any member row is written; the re-entry block *authorizes* and deliberately survives a member-row write, so a re-join attempt fails instead of silently succeeding. Only an admin `MemberAdded` lifts it.
Scenario (3 nodes, single Open subgroup):

  1. node-2 inherits Open-subgroup membership and self-joins via
     `join_subgroup_inheritance` so the subgroup key lands locally.
  2. node-2 writes; node-3 reads — proves the joiner-as-author
     direction works pre-kick.
  3. Admin (node-1) removes node-2 from the subgroup.
  4. node-2's next write is rejected by the local apply path or the
     peers' deny-list filter. `expected_failure: true` asserts the
     write does not reach node-3.
  5. node-2 calls `join_subgroup_inheritance` again — and is now
     REJECTED. Its `CAN_JOIN_OPEN_SUBGROUPS` cap at the namespace is
     still intact and its inheritance path is fully resolvable, so
     the ONLY thing standing in its way is the re-entry block. That
     makes this step a tight test of the block itself rather than of
     some incidental loss of authority.
  6. node-2 stays out: absent from the member list, still unable to
     write.
  7. Admin (node-1) re-adds node-2 with `add_group_members`. This is
     the sole way back for a removed member. The block lifts, a fresh
     `KeyDelivery` lands, and node-2 writes again; node-3 reads it.
     Bidirectional convergence is the success signal.

What this test does NOT cover (intentionally — different test):
  * The admin re-add cycle on a *Restricted* subgroup (no
    inheritance path in play) is covered by
    `group-kick-and-readd-deny-list.json`.
  * Voluntary `leave_group` and what it takes to come back from it
    is covered by `group-leave-then-rejoin-via-inheritance.json`.

Mero-chat user-visible failure mode this guards against: "I kicked someone from a public channel and they just walked straight back in."

steps.name: Install application on node-1
Node-1 creates namespace
Invite node-2 to namespace
Invite node-3 to namespace
Node-2 joins namespace
Node-3 joins namespace
Node-1 creates Open subgroup inside namespace
Mark subgroup as Open
Node-1 creates context inside Open subgroup
steps.app_name: Node-1 creates context inside Open subgroup

steps.name: Wait for subgroup visibility + context-registered ops to propagate
Node-2 self-joins Open subgroup via inheritance endpoint (#2360)
Node-2 joins context (key already local from inheritance)
Node-3 self-joins Open subgroup via inheritance endpoint (#2360)
Node-3 joins context (key already local from inheritance)
Pre-kick — node-2 writes
Pre-kick — node-3 reads node-2's write
Assert pre-kick converged
Admin (node-1) removes node-2 from Open subgroup
Confirm node-2 is gone from subgroup membership on admin
Assert node-2 absent from subgroup after kick
Cross-peer confirm node-3 also sees node-2 gone
Assert cross-peer view agrees on the kick
Post-kick — node-2 attempts to write (must fail or be dropped)
Drain in-flight gossip before negative-control read
Negative control — node-3 must NOT see the dropped write
Assert dropped value is genuinely absent on node-3 BEFORE rejoin
Node-2 attempts to re-inherit into the subgroup (must be rejected)
Confirm subgroup membership after the rejected re-inheritance
Assert the kicked member is still out
Node-2 still cannot write after the rejected re-inheritance
Admin (node-1) re-adds node-2 to the subgroup
Confirm subgroup membership shape after the admin re-add
Assert the re-added member is back in the list
Post-re-add — node-2 writes
Post-rejoin — node-3 reads node-2's write
Assert post-rejoin write reached node-3
Confirm dropped-during-kick write was NOT delivered post-re-add
Assert dropped value was indeed dropped
Confirm the write attempted during the rejected re-join was NOT delivered
Assert the rejected re-join leaked no write access
